exact.В Загребе перемены всё время шли через С: In Zagreb, change kept coming across the Sava: first the fair moved over the river, then houses started going up there, a whole new city. For a long time we still said 'going across the Sava', as if it were another country.

exact.Меня взяли в контору ярмарки. Перед откр: They took me on in the fair's office. Before an opening everyone ran about with papers, and at first I ran about just to keep them company, until I worked out where things were meant to go.
exact.Я выписывала пропуска, сверяла списки уч: I wrote out passes, checked the exhibitor lists and knew whose pavilion wasn't ready again. Every time it seemed we wouldn't make the opening, and every time we did.

exact.Меня взяли в контору Радио Загреб перепе: They took me on in the Radio Zagreb office to type up the programme schedules. I typed and was afraid the whole time that somebody would miss a concert because of my typo.

exact.На пенсию я ушла с радио. Дома приёмник: I retired from the radio. At home the set's always on, and out of habit I listen to whether they read evenly.
exact.раскрасчица на студии «Загреб-фильм»: a colourist at the Zagreb Film studio

exact.библиотекарша в университетской библиоте: a librarian at the university library

exact.На пенсию я ушла из библиотеки. Чужие кн: I retired from the library. I still straighten the dog-eared corners of other people's books without asking.
exact.помощница режиссёра на Телевидении Загре: a director's assistant at Television Zagreb

exact.На пенсию я ушла с телевидения. Новости: I retired from the television. I watch the news, but really I'm watching whether the camera wobbles.
exact.После учительской школы меня послали в с: After teacher training they sent me to a village school. I lived right there at the school, and the pupils' parents brought me firewood for the winter, a little each.
exact.Иногда на уроке сидел ещё и младший брат: Sometimes a pupil's little brother sat in on the lesson too, because there was no one to leave him with at home. He learnt the poems faster than anyone.
exact.На пенсию я ушла из школы. Письма от быв: I retired from the school. I keep letters from former pupils in a box and still correct their mistakes, in pencil, so no one can see.

exact.Я встала за прилавок в сельской лавке. Т: I went behind the counter in the village shop. It had everything at once: salt, nails, thread and paraffin, and everything smelt of everything else.

exact.Когда я была совсем маленькая, началась: When I was very small, the great war began and mobilisation was declared in Croatia. I don't remember it, I know it from what the grown-ups told me.

exact.Десятого апреля в Загреб вошли части вер: On the tenth of April Wehrmacht units entered Zagreb, and the Independent State of Croatia was proclaimed in the city. The new regime at once began dividing people and persecuting those it declared outsiders and enemies.

exact.В конце августа сорок первого в лагерь у: At the end of August 1941 the first prisoners were brought to the camp at Jasenovac. It ran longer than any other camp of that regime and was the largest, and everything that was done there only became fully known later.
